'''LG70 Loader's Gloves''' were [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] manufactured by [[Vlanth Shipping Suppliers]], designed to protect a being's hands while loading and unloading cargo. The gloves were made of heavy fabric, and reinforced with an [[exoskeleton]] of metal and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plates. The framework protected hands from being cut and crushed, and the exoskeleton could be locked in position for extra gripping endurance. While perfect for loading and unloading cargo, they were useless for fine manipulation such as firing weapons or even pushing buttons. LG70 Loader's Gloves cost a hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a pair.<ref name="PSG" />
